about.accessBody: Most people will simply use the main app URL. The deployment aliases are only fallback paths in case a direct environment link is needed.
about.heroNote: A pantry helper shaped to stay calm, practical, and easy to grow.
about.promiseBodyOne: Kamra is meant to make assisted household management feel lighter. It keeps track of what a home consumes, highlights what is running low, and turns that into a shopping plan without making the process feel like a spreadsheet chore.
about.promiseBodyTwo: The bigger promise is simple: when a weekend shop is coming up, Kamra should help a household move from stock awareness to a practical list, then toward the best place to buy it, with as little friction as possible.
about.promiseTitle: A small promise for real shopping days
about.railBody: Story, purpose, and a quiet look behind the project.
about.storyBody: The idea started in Hungary between two friends who were tired of the same small friction: running out of basics at the wrong time, then losing more time checking shop newsletters and piecing together a shopping plan. Kamra is a humble hobby project trying to merge price checking with household management so that this nagging routine can become one calmer flow.
about.summary: Kamra is a hobby project about guided household stock tracking and calmer shopping planning. It tries to connect consumption tracking, generated shopping lists, and price-aware decisions into one service without pretending that everyday grocery routines need enterprise software.
about.techBodyOne: Under the hood, the project is split into a hosted Angular frontend, thin Vercel functions, shared Node server logic, MongoDB-backed data, and supporting jobs around ingestion and cron-style workflows. GitHub Actions, Vercel, and Render keep the delivery path modular rather than hiding everything in one box.
about.techBodyTwo: That separation is useful both as a learning project and as a maintainable architecture choice. Crawling and product management stay nicely detached from household and shopping flows, which makes it easier to build distinct modules carefully until they add up to one coherent service.
about.title: About Kamra

manual.adminBody: Product and ingestion management keeps public shop data separate from household data. Admins inspect incoming source material, review changes, and maintain trusted catalogue facts deliberately.
manual.adminDisabled: Sign in as an admin to open the product and ingestion management guide.
manual.allocationDefinition: A Product's optional assignment to one Product Group. New Batches of that Product are counted in the same Group automatically, while each Batch still keeps its own dates and quantity.
manual.batchDefinition: One physical acquisition with its own quantity, stocked-at date, expiry date, and history. A later purchase is normally another Batch, not an overwrite.
manual.catalogDefinition: The curated, trusted product layer used for durable identities and reviewed facts. It is deliberately separate from raw retailer data and private household data.
manual.crawlDefinition: A retrieval of public source material from a retailer or other configured source. A crawl result is evidence to process, not automatically trusted product data.
manual.householdBody: Use household management to understand what is available, keep useful minimum and target amounts, and turn shortages into a practical shopping list. The app keeps concrete stock separate from the generic need it may satisfy.
manual.ingestionDefinition: The controlled processing of crawl evidence into normalized snapshots and review items. Ingestion does not silently publish unreviewed facts.
manual.priceObservationDefinition: A dated observation of a price or offer for a concrete shop product. It records what was seen; it is not a permanent promise.
manual.productConceptDefinition: A reusable classification label, such as milk or pasta. It is tagging vocabulary, not the concrete Product itself and not the household stock hierarchy.
manual.productDefinition: A reusable concrete identity such as a particular Pilos milk product. Several Batches can belong to the same Product while retaining separate dates and quantities.
manual.railBody: Short explanations of the terms and workflows used in Kamra.
manual.reviewDefinition: A deliberate accept, merge, decline, or correction decision that turns processed evidence into trusted catalogue data while preserving the source trail.
manual.shoppingListDefinition: A selectable plan of what to buy. It records intent and is separate from physical stock until a later purchase workflow creates new Batches.
manual.shoppingTripDefinition: A record of one shopping run. It connects the planned list with selected shop products, observed prices, and the batches created after purchase.
manual.sourceProductDefinition: A retailer-specific product record. It can be linked to a Catalog Product, but retailer wording and availability remain source-specific.
manual.stockTargetDefinition: A household-owned group of Products, such as milk or bread. It can optionally keep its own minimum and desired restock amounts; Products can keep separate targets too.
manual.summary: A short guide to the household, shopping, product, and ingestion terms used by Kamra.
manual.title: Kamra manual
